::: {.fi-standfirst}
Science knows a great deal about health, and almost none of it reaches the person
making an actual decision in a form they can use. **FRESH** is an attempt at the
missing piece: take what the evidence actually supports, make it personal and
honest, and say plainly how sure anyone can be. Not disease management. Health.

It has to be accurate, actionable, accessible, and fun, all at once, and nobody
delivers all four. A doctor has accuracy for medicine, the training to read the
science, and fifteen minutes, and a life does not fit inside a clinic. A dietitian
knows how to turn food into a recommendation but rarely has any measurement to work
from. The internet has the fun and gets paid by the click. So belief gets built
somewhere else: at dinner, in the answer you give a child who asks why one cereal is
better than another, in the headline you half-read. Nobody stands outside that, and
nobody has ever been paid to fix it. So I started building it. The longer version is
on [what we're doing](about.qmd).
:::
